introduction: Clinica Sierra Vista provides medical, dental and other care in Kern and Fresno counties. Financial assistance can reduce eligible service charges.
description: Clinica Sierra Vista provides medical, dental and other care in Kern and Fresno counties. Financial assistance can reduce eligible service charges.

sections.who: Patients can ask about care regardless of insurance or ability to pay. Sliding-fee eligibility depends on household size and income.
sections.get: Qualifying patients receive discounted services within the covered program scope. Not every outside service is included.
sections.docs:
• Photo ID and address evidence.
  • Income records such as pay stubs, tax returns or benefit letters.
  • Insurance information and medications for care visits.
sections.apply:
1. Arrange care

    Call 833-678-2781 or find a location on Clinica Sierra Vista.

  2. Request financial screening

    Apply in person without a financial-assistance appointment, or use MyChart Menu → Billing → Financial Assistance.

  3. Complete follow-up

    Provide requested documents and confirm charges before services.
sections.after: The sliding-fee approval lasts 12 months and can be renewed. Keep care and financial-assistance appointments distinct.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Clinic care and contact; Sliding Fee Scale. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
